title: Learner profile
description: What is known about one learner, keyed by capability. Outside every subject, because a learner is not a property of a physics package: the two committed profiles lived inside one, so the same learner studying a second bucket needed a duplicate. Capabilities cross subjects, so this must too.

label.description: What a person calls this profile.

provenance.description: Where the knowledge came from. DIAGNOSTIC requires an observation per DEMONSTRATED capability. SYNTHETIC_TEST is the only value an agent may write, and such a profile is never routed.

additionalProperties.description: Per capability, and never inferred from an aggregate. The role specs forbid reading mastery of a prerequisite off a high overall score, so an entry rung is selected from this map or from a waiver -- never from a percentage.

held.description: capability id -> state. The vector an entry rung is selected from.

knowledge_percentage.description: A summary the system stores and never computes from. Selecting anything from it would be the aggregate inference the role specs forbid.

support_posture.description: Standing instruction about scaffolding, from the purpose vocabulary's declared values.

owner_waiver.description: Required when there is no evidence. Absent evidence and absent waiver means personalised acceptance is held, not assumed.

measured_fit_claim.description: Must stay false unless independently established. A successfully generated book is not evidence of fit.
